sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhan+dha'i snod du hūm̐ yig zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma sha khrag gi phung po 'dod yon gyi rol mo cir yang 'char ba zag pa med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bka' skyong 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra kī la ya dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi// bka' yi srung mar dam bcas shing*// dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i g.yar dam can// shwa na bzhi dang bdag nyid ma// sa bdag chen mo mched bzhi dang*// bse lcags dung gi skyes bu bzhi// dam can srung ma 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir gshegs mthun rdzas mchod gtor bzhes// 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen spel// rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// sarba gats+tshaḥ mnyam nyid chos dbang gi bskul ngor dharma swa mis spel//
